description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Composite, which implements a composite pattern to allow multiple validators to attempt to validate CSS attribute values within the HTMLPurifier library. It manages an array of validator objects and applies them sequentially until one passes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Composite
classes.description: A composite validator that aggregates multiple HTMLPurifier_AttrDef objects to validate CSS attribute values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the composite validator with a list of HTMLPurifier_AttrDef objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Iterates over the list of validators, applying each to the input string. Returns the first successful validation result or false if none succeed.
